title: Make diagnostics source-aware and improvement intake actionable

intent.outcome: Ordinary diagnostics prioritize Git-tracked source, aggregate equivalent evidence, explain intake decisions, and derive full-proof completeness from declared dependency authority.
non_goals: Do not create a second consequence framework owned by #2310.
Do not auto-file issues from every diagnostic.
Do not hide full evidence records; keep them behind explicit detail surfaces.

effects: Change repo_friction primary scan from untracked/managed state to Git-tracked source.
Add stable evidence identities and explained deduplication before improvement candidacy.
Classify full-proof suggestions from the declared validation dependency graph.

delegation.reason: The user requested implementation in this task, and multi-agent delegation is not authorized for this turn.

next_action: Implement source classification, finding aggregation, intake deduplication, and authoritative proof completeness with bounded fixtures.

claims: Make diagnostics source-aware and improvement intake actionable is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
requirements: uv run pytest tests/test_workspace_cli.py -k 'repo_friction or improvement_intake'
